title: Setup steps agree across modes
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be any configuration of the mapping machine on input $x$ that is not in a state representing a simulated state of $M$. The one-step successor of $c$ is the same in forward and non-forward modes.
